name: External Agent Task
description: Runs an external AI agent and waits for it to finish, however long that takes. The agent reports progress by webhook; this task completes only when the agent reports a final result. The result lands in the process variables agentBusinessOutcome (approved, rejected, guardrail_blocked or empty) and agentResponse, so a gateway after this task can route on them.

properties.label: Agent URL
properties.description: Base URL of the agent server, e.g. http://localhost:8000. Must be a host the engine is allowed to call.

properties.label: Agent Name
properties.description: The application name the agent server knows this agent by.

properties.label: Run As User
properties.description: User id the agent session runs under. Leave empty to use the engine's default.

properties.label: Agent Protocol
properties.description: How the engine talks to the agent server.

properties.label: Instruction
properties.description: What you want the agent to do, in plain language, e.g. Create an expense report for this customer. Use an expression such as ${customerName} to include process data.
